🤍✨ THE WHITE GARBA 2026 ON OCT 17TH ✨🤍
(RAIN DATE OCT 18TH)

WITH DJ AXAR | BY THE LAKE (indoor/outdoor area)GUJARAT’S LATEST GARBA TREND — COMING TO JERSEY FOR THE FIRST TIME.
This Navratri, Garba gets a classy new look.
Inspired by the latest Garba fashion, energy, and festive trends coming out of Gujarat, THE WHITE GARBA brings an elevated Gujarati celebration to a stunning lakeside setting at Lake Chateau Banquets.
🤍 WHITE IS THE VIBE.
💃 GARBA IS THE TRADITION.
✨ UPSCALE IS THE EXPERIENCE.
If you want to do Garba the classy way, this is your destination.
Set beside the lake, surrounded by an elegant festive atmosphere, come dressed in your finest white Navratri look and experience Garba with a more refined, intimate, and elevated feel.

🤍 WHAT TO EXPECT✨ DJ AXAR bringing the energy with a live DJ Garba experience
🥁 LIVE DRUMS adding that raw, high-energy Garba sound
💃 DEDICATED GARBA & RAAS SECTION to dance the night away
🤍 ALL-WHITE NAVRATRI EXPERIENCE
🌅 LAKESIDE SETTING at Lake Chateau Banquets
👗 UPSCALE GARBA FASHION & FESTIVE LOOKS
🍛 INDIAN FOOD & FESTIVE VENDORS
📸 ELEGANT, PICTURE-PERFECT ATMOSPHERE
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 A CELEBRATION FOR FAMILY & FRIENDS

👗🤍 DRESS TO IMPRESSThis is not your ordinary Garba night.
Bring your best white Navratri look.
Think elegant chaniya cholis, contemporary Gujarati fashion, kediyus, mirror work, traditional jewelry, sophisticated festive styling, and modern Garba looks.
WHITE IS THE DRESS CODE.
CLASSY IS THE ATTITUDE.

🌅 GARBA BY THE LAKEImagine dancing Garba as the sun sets over the water.
The dhol and drums kick in.
The DJ takes you through the latest Garba sounds.
The Raas circle comes alive.
And the entire lakefront transforms into a sea
